bytes_per_tick_source: Plan SW-R8.1: 0-allocation hot path. Enforced by the counting allocator (tests/alloc_gate.rs, 10 000 ticks per section) and the alloc_probe_* benches (panic on any allocation). Any allocation is a BUG with its site, never a reason to raise this.
description: Phase B5 benchmark gate thresholds (SW-R8.1). Enforced by tools/rsh-benchmarks/check-thresholds.py over `cargo bench -p rsh-benchmarks` criterion estimates; the allocation gate is additionally enforced in-process by tests/alloc_gate.rs and the alloc_probe_* benches, and the soak gate by tests/soak.rs (60 s proxy) plus the Phase H 10-min rig soak.
hot_path_tick_ns_source: Measured baseline on this machine (3 criterion runs, 2026-11-21, Round 3 quiet re-measure R3-04): hot_path_parse_seq_pipeline mean-of-means 303.2 ns (runs 305.8 / 303.6 / 300.1, spread 1.9%); threshold = measured x 1.2 = 364 ns (+20% headroom). Supersedes the 2026-11-14 baseline (335.6 ns -> 403 ns): bench bodies changed since (engine.rs real accept path, protocol v2.2 dropped HMAC) and the old threshold guarded a stale measurement. Re-measure on a new machine; do not raise without a new measurement.

measured_baseline_ns.note: Mean-of-means of 3 `cargo bench -p rsh-benchmarks` runs, 2026-11-21 (Round 3 quiet re-measure R3-04, merged tree aa66d75). Runs: pipeline 162.4 / 160.8 / 161.0 ns; hot path 305.8 / 303.6 / 300.1 ns; seq+watchdog 11.2 / 10.9 / 11.2 ns. Spread 1.0-2.8% on engine benches; all 19 benches 1.0-11.1% except sequence_gap_max 24.1% (15.0/18.6/19.3 ns — tiny bench, few-ns noise). Supersedes the 2026-11-14 baselines (pipeline 162.8, hot path 335.6, watchdog 13.9).

pin_validate_blob_factory_ns_source: H-6: 1.5x the measured baseline (mean-of-means 8553.4 ns, 3 runs 2026-11-21, Round 3 quiet re-measure R3-04, baseline/runs-summary.json; runs 8973.8 / 8303.0 / 8383.6, spread 7.8%). Supersedes the 2026-11-14 baseline (6585.6 ns -> 9879 ns). Pin validation is a cold path (config time, not the 200 Hz hot path) but it still gets a threshold — exempt in writing is not a threshold. Re-measure on a new machine; do not raise without a new measurement.
pin_validate_factory_modules_ns_source: H-6: 1.5x the measured baseline (mean-of-means 4938.7 ns, 3 runs 2026-11-21, Round 3 quiet re-measure R3-04, baseline/runs-summary.json; runs 4999.4 / 4903.1 / 4913.6, spread 2.0%). Supersedes the 2026-11-14 baseline (4533.8 ns -> 6801 ns). Same rule as pin_validate_blob_factory_ns_max.
regression_factor_source: M-2/H-6: any criterion bench whose mean exceeds 1.25x its measured baseline (baseline/runs-summary.json mean_of_means_ns for protocol benches, measured_baseline_ns for engine benches) FAILS the gate. The 1.25x factor is tighter than the 1.5x plan-SLO headroom on purpose: it catches regressions early, on this shared host where run-to-run spread is up to ~18% (pin_validate). A failure here means re-measure and explain, not silently raise.
regression_min_headroom_ns_source: R3-04 follow-up (CI run 44951002437): noise floor for the regression gate — a bench's limit is max(1.25x baseline, baseline + 10 ns). A flat 1.25x band is narrower than measurement noise for sub-40 ns benches: sequence_gap_max (baseline 17.7 ns, local 3-run spread 24%) measured 24.2 ns on a loaded CI runner and failed a 22.1 ns limit, while byte-identical measured code passed the same gate in run 44947397802. The 10 ns floor covers the observed noise (+6.5 ns over baseline) with margin and only binds for baselines under 40 ns (10 / 0.25); the 1.25x factor still governs every larger bench, and the baseline itself is NOT raised — a genuine 2x regression still fails.
pipeline_tick_ns_source: C# baseline (RSH-RUST-ARCHITECTURE.md Phase B / RSH-RUST-SOFTWARE-PLAN.md SW-R8.1): pipeline tick <= 1.1 us/tick. Measured Rust baseline on this machine (3 runs, 2026-11-14): mean-of-means 162.8 ns — 6.8x under the cap; the cap is the plan SLO, not the measured number.
soak_growth_source: RSH-RUST-SOFTWARE-PLAN.md SW-R8.3: memory flatness <= 1 MB / 10 min. The 60 s proxy in tests/soak.rs asserts 0 net heap bytes (pro-rated budget ~100 KiB/60 s) and RSS growth within the full 1 MiB; the full 10-min soak is the Phase H release gate.
